"""Helpers to build synthetic campaigns and KTEST payloads."""
import base64, json, struct, subprocess, sys

CLI = "/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py"

def ktest(objects, args=(), version=3, symargv=(0, 0), trailing=b'', magic=b'KTEST'):
    out = magic + struct.pack('>I', version) + struct.pack('>I', len(args))
    for a in args:
        out += struct.pack('>I', len(a)) + a
    out += struct.pack('>I', symargv[0]) + struct.pack('>I', symargv[1])
    out += struct.pack('>I', len(objects))
    for name, data in objects:
        if isinstance(name, str):
            name = name.encode()
        if isinstance(data, int):
            data = int(data).to_bytes(1, 'little', signed=False)
        out += struct.pack('>I', len(name)) + name + struct.pack('>I', len(data)) + data
    out += trailing
    return base64.b64encode(out).decode()

def u(value, width):
    return int(value).to_bytes(width, 'little', signed=False)

def run(campaign, expect_error=False):
    payload = json.dumps(campaign).encode()
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", CLI], input=payload,
                          capture_output=True)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise AssertionError("exit %d stderr=%s" % (proc.returncode, proc.stderr.decode()[:4000]))
    text = proc.stdout.decode()
    if expect_error:
        assert json.loads(text) == {"error": "INVALID_INPUT"}, text
        return {"error": "INVALID_INPUT"}
    value = json.loads(text)
    return value
PYEOF
